N:ARROWGREEN.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 200.5 Cr (-17.6%), EBITDA Rs 64.6 Cr, PAT Rs 47.4 Cr (-24.8%; margin 22.7% vs 25.3%). Q4 FY26 revenue -27%, PAT Rs 7.4 Cr vs Rs 11.4 Cr. Green segment (water-soluble/biodegradable films) +52% to Rs 36.9 Cr (18% of revenue); High-tech (security/anti-counterfeit products, e.g. watermarked paper, tax stamps) contracted on lumpy orders. 24 patents granted. Kotak Neo reports Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 89.9 Cr and PAT Rs 27.4 Cr (unverified), which would be a sharp rebound. Lumpy, order-driven high-tech revenue is the key risk.

N:FRONTSP.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 322.1 Cr (+39.2% from Rs 231.3 Cr), PAT Rs 61.3 Cr (+76.9% from Rs 34.7 Cr), EBITDA Rs 86.3 Cr, margin 26.8% (21.5% in FY25). Q4 FY26 revenue Rs 82.5 Cr, PAT Rs 16.6 Cr. Order book ~Rs 370 Cr. FY27 guidance: revenue > Rs 500 Cr at 23-24% EBITDA margin. Coil, forged and air springs (historically Indian Railways rolling stock: LHB coaches, Vande Bharat air springs); diversifying into auto and construction equipment. Bonus issue and Rs 0.7 dividend recommended. FY26 net cash flow reported at -Rs 1.7 Cr (single source).

N:JSLL.s4: FY26 revenue ~Rs 801 Cr (+71% from Rs 469 Cr), PAT ~Rs 222 Cr (+178% from Rs 80 Cr), EBITDA Rs 349.6 Cr at a 44% margin (30% in FY25). Zero debt; Rs 4.50 dividend. Ayurveda hospitals, clinics and Panchakarma under the HiiMS brand; shifting toward private/retail patients (historically meaningful government-scheme/panel business), expanding beds; bought 51% of a UAE Ayurveda firm. A 44% EBITDA margin in hospitals is unusual and needs to be understood (pricing, mix, government reimbursement).

N:SRM.s4: FY26 revenue ~Rs 1,026 Cr (+94%), PAT Rs 111 Cr (+102%); Q4 FY26 revenue ~Rs 446 Cr, PAT ~Rs 54 Cr (+125%). Order book Rs 1,844 Cr (Mar-26) to >Rs 2,000-3,000 Cr after wins (sources differ), incl. Rs 483 Cr Nashik Ring Road EPC. FY27 guidance Rs 1,400-1,750 Cr revenue, PAT margin 8.75-10.25%. Roads, tunnels, slope stabilisation; origins in J&K, now national. Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 196 Cr (+40%), PAT Rs 19.7 Cr (+55%). Government-client EPC: execution, retention money and receivables are the swing factors.

B:544406.s4: FY26 revenue ~Rs 288 Cr (+30.8% from Rs 220.3 Cr; Trendlyne/scanx say ~Rs 302 Cr), PAT ~Rs 40.8 Cr (+19%); margins compressed on business mix. Rs 5.50 dividend. IT infrastructure integration plus AMC services (e.g. Rs 4.24 Cr follow-on AMC order from a private bank). Board approved entry into a safety-equipment business, an unrelated diversification and a governance watch-point. Listed on BSE SME May-2025.

N:MODISONLTD.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 710.3 Cr (+45%), consolidated PAT Rs 72.6 Cr (+194%); Rs 3 dividend. Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 33.8 Cr (+605% YoY). Products: silver/silver-alloy and copper-tungsten electrical contacts and silver oxide compounds for switchgear (LV/MV/HV) makers. Much of the profit jump tracks the silver price (inventory and hedge gains; hedge MTM booked as exceptional items), so FY26-27 earnings are partly a commodity windfall. A fire hit the Vapi plant; operations restored. CFO not found. Normalised to FY26 PAT (Rs 72.6 Cr) for scoring: P/E ~15.6 instead of the TTM 9.8 that includes the silver-windfall Q1 FY27; the feed's 3Y profit CAGR is dropped.

N:CRIZAC.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 1,042.2 Cr (+22.7%), PAT Rs 219.1 Cr (+41.4%), EBITDA Rs 282.4 Cr (+31%). CFO ~Rs 144 Cr (-23% YoY), FCF ~Rs 127 Cr (stockanalysis); Rs 8/share interim dividend (~Rs 140 Cr outflow). ~97% of revenue from the UK; ~394,000 applications processed. B2B platform connecting recruitment agents with universities (commission per enrolled student). Acquired Global Tree. Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 208.4 Cr (-4% YoY), PAT Rs 47.1 Cr (+2.9%): growth stalling. UK visa/dependant-rule tightening is the dominant risk.

B:544150.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 1,245.6 Cr (+79% from Rs 694.6 Cr), PAT Rs 135.7 Cr (+85% from Rs 73.5 Cr), EBITDA Rs 249 Cr (+117%), PBT Rs 184.4 Cr. Order book Rs 1,831 Cr (31-Mar-26) plus Rs 507.9 Cr of orders on 1-May-26. KP Group engineering arm: lattice transmission towers, solar module-mounting structures, galvanised fabrication, substation structures. Group sister companies (KPI Green, KP Energy) are likely large customers, so related-party share of revenue must be checked. CFO not found.

N:KRISHNADEF.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 244.8 Cr (+29.1%), PAT Rs 41.3 Cr (+85.6%), EBITDA margin 21.3% (+511 bps); Q4 revenue Rs 64.8 Cr (+42%), PAT Rs 12.8 Cr (+73%). Order book Rs 103.4 Cr (31-Mar-26) plus tender pipeline Rs 221 Cr: under half a year of revenue, so the order book is thin. Special-steel and fabricated items for naval shipbuilding (MoD contract ~Rs 45.6 Cr for special steel supplies; pipeline includes next-gen corvettes). Management targets ~30% annual growth for 3-5 years.

N:GULPOLY.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 2,312 Cr, PAT Rs 107.2 Cr (+332%), EBITDA margin 10.0%; Q3 FY26 PAT Rs 40.9 Cr (+504%). Segments: ethanol/distillery (810 KLPD total, sells to oil-marketing companies under the blending programme), grain processing (sorbitol capacity 15k -> 60k MT, starch, fructose; domestic oversupply squeezing margins), mineral processing (calcium carbonate). Ethanol ramp-up drove the year; management expects full distillery utilisation in FY26-27. Policy risk: OMC allocations, FCI rice pricing, feedstock (grain) costs.

N:APCOTEXIND.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 1,441.5 Cr (+3.5%), PAT Rs 101.4 Cr (+87.6% from Rs 54.1 Cr); Q4 revenue ~Rs 398 Cr (+14%) with ~Rs 18 Cr one-off provisions. Net cash ~Rs 70 Cr, debt cut sharply; Rs 5.5 dividend; Rs 210 Cr capacity expansion under way; buying a captive solar-power stake. Synthetic latex and rubber (nitrile/SBR/VP latex) for paper coating, carpets, tyre cord, construction and gloves. Profit growth came from margin recovery, not volume; revenue growth is low.

N:DYCL.s4: FY26 revenue ~Rs 1,198 Cr (+17%), PAT Rs 84.4 Cr (+30%), EBITDA Rs 129.6 Cr; Q4 revenue +7% with margin pressure (stock fell ~19% on results). Order book Rs 808 Cr (Mar-26) -> Rs 829 Cr (Sep-26). Q1 FY27 total income +32%, PAT +37%; Q2 FY27 revenue +29%, PAT +13%; H1 FY27 PAT Rs 47.1 Cr, operating margin 10.4%. Bank-facility ratings withdrawn at the company's request. Power cables and conductors for discoms/EPC contractors and railways.

N:SOTL.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 4,362.6 Cr (record), PAT Rs 181.8 Cr (+60.6%), PBT Rs 244.4 Cr; cash Rs 130.7 Cr; 250% dividend. Q1 FY27 PAT reported ~Rs 292 Cr on Rs 1,470 Cr revenue (EBITDA margin ~26% vs 8.3% a year earlier): a one-quarter windfall, probably inventory/base-oil price gains. The screener's TTM P/E of 7.6 includes that quarter; normalised to FY26 PAT the P/E is ~24.5, and the feed's 3Y profit CAGR is dropped as unreliable. Transformer oils, white oils, automotive/industrial lubricants (Savsol); merger with Savita GreenTec pending.

N:TAC.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 57.3 Cr (+88%), EBITDA Rs 30.8 Cr (53.8% margin), PAT Rs 26.4 Cr (+78%). H1 was lifted by two large partner-led orders (~US$1M); H2 PAT fell 31% vs H1. Collected Rs 45.6 Cr against FY26 invoicing (~80%). Q1 FY27 revenue Rs 20.0 Cr, PAT ~Rs 8 Cr. Vulnerability-management / risk-quantification SaaS (ESOF platform), NSE SME listed. Very small revenue base; lumpy large deals.

N:GANDHITUBE.s4: FY26 revenue Rs 191.8 Cr (+11.1%), PAT Rs 68.4 Cr (+16.5%); Q4 PAT fell ~21% to Rs 9.4 Cr; Q1 FY27 PAT Rs 27.9 Cr (+29%). Rs 15 dividend plus a ~Rs 78 Cr buyback at up to Rs 900/share. Seamless and welded precision steel tubes and nuts (Halol, Gujarat; 1,800 t seamless + 2,400 t welded capacity) for auto/hydraulics/boilers, plus wind power. Operating margin ex-other-income ~41%: an unusually profitable niche, but small and slow-growing.
